answer: Bind each identity to its own hardware. At registration and at every epoch's summit check, an agent must return a fresh remote-attestation quote signed by a TPM endorsement key, and the chain rejects any key already tied to another account: one chip, one voice. A farmer wanting 500 accounts must buy, power and keep online 500 separate machines, each costing far more than the walnut-sized reward one fake earns. No sonnet of clever prompts can forge a signature from silicon it does not own.
